name: smwsprites-toxic-timed-lift
title: Toxic Timed Lift
description:
This is a toxic variant of the Timed Lift (Sprite BA), which can hurt or kill Mario. You can customize the time it lasts for (1-9 seconds), the X and Y speeds, and toggle additional behaviours, all with the extra bytes. There are also defines in the .asm file that let you change the palette and tiles used.

By default, the .asm and custom sprite list are preset to meet the specifications of the request. See the .asm file for customization options.

Requested by RZRider.
